summary: Google DeepMind released version 0.7.0 of the AlphaGenome toolkit, adding a FASTA extractor and a splicing-variant scoring colab, and changing stranded track merging and transcript arrow plotting.

practices.reason: Teams using AlphaGenome gain a new FASTA input extractor and altered track-merging behavior, which changes how data is fed into the tool but is a minor interface update.
practices.quote: Fasta extractor for reading DNA sequences.
